description: This is a test class for the UserService class in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing various functions like saving users, password verification, and credential retrieval within the context of administrative service layer.

classes.name: UserServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for the UserService class, covering user saving, password checks, credentials retrieval, and undeletable user IDs.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the UserService instance before each test.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Creates and returns a UserRole object with predefined admin role attributes.

methods.name: testSaveSystemUserNoPasswordChange
methods.description: Tests saving a system user without a password change, ensuring the user object is returned correctly.

methods.name: testSaveSystemUserWithPasswordChange
methods.description: Verifies that when changing the password, it is hashed before being saved.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordUserNotFound
methods.description: Checks behavior when the user is not found in the database.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordTrue
methods.description: Confirms that the password verification successfully matches the user's password.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordWithNullPassword
methods.description: Tests the case where the user has no password set; verification should fail.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordOldHash
methods.description: Checks that an old MD5 hash password is correctly verified.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordFalse
methods.description: Ensures verification fails when the password does not match.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsUserNotFound
methods.description: Tests credential retrieval when the user does not exist; expects null.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsValidPassword
methods.description: Verifies credential retrieval when provided with correct username and password, resulting in user object.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsOldHash
methods.description: Checks migration from old MD5 hash passwords to bcrypt when user credentials are fetched.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsInvalidPassword
methods.description: Verifies that invalid password yields null.

methods.name: testGetUndeletableUserIds
methods.description: Tests retrieval of user IDs that are protected from deletion based on their roles.
